name: Magicam
description_en:
Magicam offers real-time face and voice changes, video face swapping and a virtual-camera workflow for calls or streaming. It is a desktop performance and capture task, not merely uploading an image for a still edit.

The homepage says processing is local and recommends a dedicated GPU, preferably RTX 2070 or above. Those are vendor statements; this research did not install the software, observe network behavior or measure frame rate.
description_zh:
Magicam 提供实时换脸/声音、视频换脸及会议/直播虚拟摄像头，是桌面性能和采集任务，不只是静图上传。

首页称本地处理，建议独显、最好 RTX 2070 以上；这是厂商说明，本文未安装、观察网络或测帧率。

core_features.explanation_en: Route a transformed authorized face into a capture/call workflow.
core_features.explanation_zh: 将变换后的授权面孔送入采集/会议流程。

core_features.explanation_en: Adjust swaps/voice features, with higher-quality controls on Pro.
core_features.explanation_zh: 调整换脸/声音，Pro 列较高质量控制。

en: Record an authorized transformed-camera demo and verify audio/video sync.
zh: 录授权变换镜头演示并核音画同步。

sources.title: Magicam, The Ultimate Real-Time Face Swap Solution
sources.research_notes_en: Real-time face/voice change, video swaps, virtual camera and dedicated-GPU guidance; local-processing claim not independently verified.

sources.title: Magicam, The Ultimate Real-Time Face Swap Solution
sources.research_notes_en: Price evidence is homepage itself: Free and Pro promo/reference pairs, $8.99/$29.99 monthly and $49.9/$198.99 yearly; standalone pricing returned server error.

official_check.scope: Public official documents read; no purchase, account setup, independent review, hands-on test, identity verification or publication approval.

review_notes: Official documentation describes vendor functionality, not independent evidence of reliability, adoption or outcomes.
Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese draft; examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance.
Current public pricing is a dated snapshot; purchase conditions remain subject to vendor confirmation.

sections.en: For an illustrative recorded demonstration, use a consenting subject, select the virtual camera in the recording app and inspect lighting, occlusion, lip movement and audio sync. Test returning to the original camera and voice. A convincing preview does not prove stable behavior through another app, screen sharing or a dropped device.
sections.zh: 例如录制演示，应使用同意人物、在录制应用选虚拟镜头，核光照、遮挡、口型及同步，并测返回原镜头/声音。预览可信不证明其他应用、共享屏幕或设备掉线稳定。

sections.en: The homepage shows Free and Pro, with $8.99 and $29.99 beside monthly labels, and $49.9/$198.99 beside yearly labels. The returned text does not preserve which number is discounted/reference or what renewal applies. Pro lists 4K video, enhanced models, tuning, unlimited voice cloning and no watermark. Verify entitlement and checkout; the standalone price route returned a server error.
sections.zh: 首页 Free/Pro，月标签旁 $8.99/$29.99，年标签旁 $49.9/$198.99；返回文字未可靠保留划价/促价及续费。Pro 列 4K、增强模型、调节、不限声音克隆和无水印，需核权益/结算，独立价格路径服务器错误。

sections.title_en: Verify local processing and hardware behavior
sections.title_zh: 验证本地处理及硬件行为
sections.en: Local-processing language is not an independent audit of telemetry, downloads, authentication or every product mode. Check system requirements, driver compatibility, network activity and app permissions using a nonconfidential pilot. No supported operating-system inventory or minimum sustained frame rate was established.
sections.zh: 本地处理表述不等于独立审计遥测、下载、认证或所有模式。应以非机密试点核系统、驱动、网络及权限，本文未建立完整系统支持或最低持续帧率。

sections.title_en: Choose real-time transformation with transparent use
sections.en: Magicam merits investigation for authorized creative recording where identity transformation is disclosed appropriately. It is not evidence of identity verification or a replacement for an actual person’s consent. No installation, virtual camera, voice cloning, video export or privacy control was tested. Refund, data retention, source licensing and self-hosting terms remain unknown.
sections.zh: 适合研究获授权、适当披露身份变换的创意录制，不能作为身份验证或替代本人同意。本文未安装、测虚拟镜头、声音克隆、视频导出或隐私，退款、保留、源码许可及自托管未知。

research_gaps: No installation, GPU performance, camera, voice, export or local-processing assertion tested.
Promotion/renewal/refund, OS support, retained data, source license and self-hosting unverified.
